title: Kitchen Cabinet FAQ — Designer, Ordering, Pricing & Shipping | CabinetDealz
description: Answers about the CabinetDealz Designer, ordering, member and trade pricing, the affiliate and pro network, shipping, customization, assembly, returns, and warranty. Contact us in Osprey, FL for a quote or project help.
intro: Common questions about designing, pricing, and ordering cabinets on CabinetDealz. If your question is not listed, call or email us before you place the order — it is easier to sort out details first than after a shipment is on the way.

entries.question: How do I start designing my kitchen?
entries.answer: Begin with how you use the room — where you prep, cook, clean up, and store things — and with the measurements you have. You can start from a kitchen look or a ready-to-customize Kitchen Package, then open the Designer and place those work areas on your walls. Style and finish are easier to settle once the layout works. Room measurements help you organize the plan; a local CabinetDealz store can confirm exact numbers before anything is ordered.

entries.question: How does the CabinetDealz Designer work?
entries.answer: The Designer is a browser-based kitchen planning tool on CabinetDealz. You set the room size, build wall runs, place cabinets and appliances, and review a live materials list and quote as you go. You can inspect the layout in 3D, save your work, and come back later — there is no software to download. A separate Designer Guide walks through the same order a kitchen comes together: room first, cabinet plan next, then finishes, review, and a saved design.

entries.question: What is Auto Design?
entries.answer: Auto Design is a feature inside the Designer. After you set up the room, it can build a starter cabinet layout from your room and appliance choices. You can then review the plan, adjust cabinets and finishes, and keep editing in the Designer as you would with a layout you started by hand.

entries.question: What do I need to measure before I start?
entries.answer: Measure each wall corner to corner, the ceiling height, and every window, door, and opening from the nearest corner. Note where the sink, range, refrigerator, outlets, and water lines sit today. Rough numbers are enough for a first layout; exact measurements should be confirmed before an order is placed.

entries.question: How long does it take to make a first layout?
entries.answer: Most people can put together a first complete layout in about 10 to 15 minutes. You can save the plan, return to it, and change the layout, style, and cabinet selections as the project develops.

entries.question: Can I start with a kitchen package instead of a blank room?
entries.answer: Yes. Kitchen Packages are a ready-to-customize starting point. You can use a package to get a complete kitchen direction, then move into the Designer to fit the plan to your room and request a quote when you are ready to talk through the project.

entries.question: What is the kitchen work triangle, and does it still matter?
entries.answer: It is the path between the sink, range, and refrigerator. A common planning guideline is to keep each leg between 4 and 9 feet, and the three sides together between 13 and 26 feet, so you are not crossing the room for every step. Avoid letting a walkway or island cut through that path.

entries.question: How much space do I need between counters or around an island?
entries.answer: Plan on at least 42 inches of walkway for one cook and 48 inches if two people work at once. Measure from the front edge of the countertop, not only the cabinet box — a standard 1.5 inch overhang on each side uses 3 inches of the aisle. Also check that dishwasher, oven, and refrigerator doors can open without blocking the walkway.

entries.question: How should I handle corners, and why is a filler on my quote?
entries.answer: Two standard cabinets cannot meet squarely in a corner without their doors or drawers hitting. Common options are a lazy Susan, a diagonal corner, or a blind corner with a pull-out. A filler is a narrow matching strip that closes a gap, usually at a wall or beside a corner so a neighboring drawer can open. It is a real part, cut to fit. The Designer applies the cabinet geometry and fillers for the corner you choose. If a plan shows several fillers in the middle of a run, the cabinet widths can often be chosen more cleanly.

entries.question: Why is the finished countertop deeper than a 24-inch cabinet?
entries.answer: Standard base cabinets are 24 inches deep. The countertop typically adds a 1.5 inch overhang past the doors, for a finished depth around 25.5 inches. That is the number your tape measure will hit, and the number to use when you check aisle clearance.

entries.question: Can I see the kitchen before I buy?
entries.answer: Yes. You can inspect the layout in 3D in the Designer and work with your local CabinetDealz store on a presentation before anything is ordered. The quote and materials list update as you add or change cabinets, including fillers and crown molding where they apply.

entries.question: Should I design the kitchen myself or work with a designer?
entries.answer: Either approach works. Many people build a first plan in the Designer, then have a local CabinetDealz store review it before ordering to catch anything that needs adjustment. You can also contact us and we will help you take the next step.

entries.question: How does ordering work on CabinetDealz?
entries.answer: CabinetDealz brings the catalog, design tools, and a path to a quote and order together in one place. You can browse cabinets and styles, build a layout in the Designer, start from a Kitchen Package, or use Build an Order to assemble a list. When you are ready, request a quote or check out. CabinetDealz is the seller of record for transactions processed on the platform. Orders are not confirmed until payment is successfully processed, and we may cancel an order because of a pricing error, stock availability, or suspected fraud.

entries.question: Can I place an order by phone?
entries.answer: No. Orders cannot be placed by phone. All orders must go through the website.

entries.question: How do I pay for an order?
entries.answer: Prices are in US dollars and may change without notice. Payment is processed securely through Stripe at checkout, and you authorize the charge when you place the order. Full payment is required before an order is processed, including backorders and approved written add-ons. If you have a question about a payment method, contact us before you check out.

entries.question: How can I check the status of an order?
entries.answer: After an order ships, a tracking number is emailed the next day. You can also sign in to your account, or email sales@cabinetdealz.com or call (941) 899-3288 with your order number and we will help you look it up.

entries.question: Do you charge sales tax?
entries.answer: Sales tax is collected based on the delivery address, in accordance with applicable state law. When tax applies, it is calculated as part of the order. If you have a tax question, contact us or your local tax authority.

entries.question: Can I change a color, finish, or cabinet after I order?
entries.answer: Not once the order has been released. That is why the last step before ordering is confirming the door style, the color or finish, and every cabinet on the list.

entries.question: What is member or trade pricing?
entries.answer: CabinetDealz is a trade platform for distributors, dealers, affiliates, and homeowners. Member and trade pricing are built into the platform, so qualified buyers see those prices as they browse and design rather than negotiating each line by hand. Contact us if you need help understanding the pricing that applies to your account.

entries.question: When will I know what my kitchen costs?
entries.answer: The Designer updates the quote and materials list as soon as you start placing cabinets, including fillers and crown molding where they apply. You can also request a quote once you have a kitchen direction, package, or layout you want to discuss as a complete project.

entries.question: Do you match prices from other sellers?
entries.answer: Send us an invoice and we'll give you an opportunity to match it.

sections.title: Affiliates, dealers, and the pro network

entries.question: How does the Affiliate Program work?
entries.answer: Affiliates can launch a branded kitchen and bath storefront on the CabinetDealz catalog, with trade pricing and fulfillment included. Membership is annual or monthly, and you do not need to stock inventory. Affiliates get a custom-branded storefront, access to cabinets and related products, the 3D Designer on their storefront, and fulfillment from the supply network. Orders placed through the storefront can earn a commission. Affiliates are independent contractors. The full program terms are in the Affiliate Agreement.

entries.question: What is the Pro Network?
entries.answer: The Pro Network is how licensed trade professionals can apply to work with CabinetDealz. If you are a contractor or other trade professional, you can review the Pro Network page and submit an application. Dealers and other members also use the platform to move a project from planning toward an order.

entries.question: Who is CabinetDealz for, and where are you located?
entries.answer: CabinetDealz brings a cabinet catalog, kitchen design tools, and an affiliate and dealer network together so homeowners and trade professionals can take a project from selection to a supported next step. We are based at 470 N Tamiami Trail, Osprey, FL 34229, and we serve customers nationwide through affiliate partners and distributor relationships. Hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Saturday by appointment, and Sunday closed.

entries.question: Where do you ship?
entries.answer: We ship to the 48 contiguous United States only. We do not ship to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, or international destinations. If you have a delivery question about a specific address, contact us and we will check it with you.

entries.question: How are cabinets shipped, and how long will they take?
entries.answer: Orders are fulfilled by our authorized vendor network, so timing depends on the product, whether the order ships flat-pack or assembled, and the delivery address. Shipping charges for typical freight orders are calculated at checkout. Many cabinet orders ship on a pallet with a less-than-truckload (LTL) carrier. For framed cabinetry from our primary vendor, the published processing times are: flat-pack orders ship within 3 full business days under Express Advantage shipping, and assembled orders are processed and shipped within 15 full business days. “Day One” is the next full business day after the order is placed. Standard LTL transit is 2–5 business days; allow at least one extra day for residential deliveries and deliveries that need a scheduled appointment. Other vendors may have different terms. The full details, including rush options, limited-access fees, and delivery rules, are on the Shipping Policy page.

entries.question: How much does shipping cost? Is there free shipping?
entries.answer: Shipping costs are calculated from order size, weight, delivery ZIP code, and the fulfilling distributor’s warehouse location. LTL freight charges are calculated at checkout. We do not publish a free-shipping threshold on this page. If an order is fulfilled by more than one distributor, shipments may arrive at different times. For a shipping question or a quote, email sales@cabinetdealz.com or call (941) 899-3288.

entries.question: Is warehouse pickup available?
entries.answer: Yes. Warehouse pickup is available. Contact us if you would like to arrange pickup for an order.

entries.question: Can I choose my delivery date?
entries.answer: For residential deliveries and deliveries that need an appointment, the freight company contacts you about 24 hours in advance to set a delivery window, usually 3–4 hours. A responsible party must be present to inspect, inventory, and sign for the delivery. Lift-gate service, when selected at checkout, means the driver places the pallet on the ground; you should plan for help moving cartons from there. Contact us if you have a question about scheduling a delivery.

entries.question: What if my delivery is damaged or missing pieces?
entries.answer: Accept the delivery — do not reject damaged items. A responsible party must be present to inspect the shipment. Note visible damage or a short pallet count on the delivery paperwork when you sign, and take photos. For our primary vendor’s framed cabinetry, visible damage, shortages, and concealed damage must be reported within 5 business days of delivery with photos (include the original packaging for concealed damage). Then email sales@cabinetdealz.com with your order number, a description of the issue, photos, and your signed delivery receipt. We will contact the vendor and, if needed, provide a return authorization. Other vendors may have different claim windows, which are listed on the Return Policy page. Failure to document the delivery can delay or prevent a claim.

entries.question: Can I choose door styles, finishes, and related products?
entries.answer: Yes. Browse door styles by finish in the catalog and Shop by Style, and try styles and finishes in the Designer while you build the layout. CabinetDealz also carries related kitchen and bath products such as surfaces, countertops, and fixtures. Construction details and available options are listed on the style and product pages, because they vary by line.

entries.question: Can cabinets be modified, or can I buy doors only?
entries.answer: No. CabinetDealz does not modify anything. We do not offer door modifications or custom modifications. The catalog is sold as complete cabinets and related kitchen products, in the options and finishes each line already offers.

entries.question: Can I order a sample door?
entries.answer: Yes. Sample doors are available now for $30 and can be ordered right away through the website.

entries.question: How do I pick a door color when the screen looks different in my kitchen?
entries.answer: Order a physical sample door and look at it in your own light. Screens are backlit and color-managed; a supplier’s own door photo is closer to the real finish, and that is the kind of image the Designer draws from. Sample doors are available now for $30 and can be ordered right away through the website.

entries.question: Why do some door styles take longer than others?
entries.answer: Lines marked special order are made for your job rather than pulled from warehouse stock. Lead time is shown on the style so you can plan around it. If you are working to a deadline, ask which stocked styles are close to the look you want.

entries.question: Do the cabinets arrive assembled or as flat-pack?
entries.answer: Both options exist, depending on the product and the choices made on the order. The Shipping Policy describes separate processing times for flat-pack and assembled orders from our primary vendor, and other vendors may offer different packing options. The checkout and product information for your order will reflect how that shipment is being fulfilled. Contact us if you need to confirm how a specific order will arrive.

entries.question: Do you install the cabinets, include installation hardware, or recommend an installer?
entries.answer: CabinetDealz provides the catalog, design tools, and order support. We do not publish an installer referral list or a standard hardware kit that ships with every cabinet, because installation needs vary by structure and local code. Plan to work with a qualified local installer and to follow the building requirements that apply to your project. If you have an installation question about a specific cabinet, contact us.

entries.question: What is your return policy?
entries.answer: CabinetDealz is an authorized dealer for the cabinet manufacturers that fulfill orders on the platform. Returns, exchanges, and warranty claims follow the policy of the manufacturer that fulfilled your order. We facilitate the claim and work with you and the vendor. Do not ship anything back until you have written authorization — unauthorized returns may be refused. Refunds or replacements are processed under the applicable vendor policy. The complete terms, which differ by manufacturer, are on the Return Policy page.

entries.question: What warranty comes with the cabinets?
entries.answer: Warranty coverage depends on the manufacturer that fulfilled your order and is limited to the terms published for that line. Coverage, time periods, and exclusions differ by vendor — for example, some lines publish a five-year limited residential warranty, and others publish their own limited warranty language. Warranties typically address manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship under normal residential use, require proof of purchase, and may be limited to the original purchaser at the original installation site. The Warranty page reproduces the manufacturer wording in full.

entries.question: How do I file a return, damage, or warranty claim?
entries.answer: Email sales@cabinetdealz.com with your order number and a description of the issue. Include photos of the item, any packaging damage, and your signed delivery receipt. We will contact the vendor on your behalf and provide a return authorization number if one applies. For urgent matters, call (941) 899-3288 during business hours (Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET; Saturday by appointment).

entries.question: How do I get in touch with CabinetDealz?
entries.answer: Call or text (941) 899-3288 during business hours, or email sales@cabinetdealz.com — we respond within 1 business day. We are at 470 N Tamiami Trail, Osprey, FL 34229. Hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Saturday by appointment, and Sunday closed. We can help with cabinet orders, design questions, affiliate inquiries, and vendor partnerships.
